---
name: sequence_alignment
description: Domain knowledge for short-read alignment and post-alignment processing.
---

# Sequence Alignment

Domain knowledge for aligning short reads to a reference genome and
processing the resulting alignments.

## Expected Workflow

1. Check the dataset and assay facts first:
   - read layout
   - assay type
   - reference genome and index
   - whether downstream steps depend on pairing semantics
2. Choose an aligner and mode that match the assay instead of reusing a
   familiar default blindly.
3. Treat mapping rate and summary statistics as a sanity check on the
   reference and alignment mode.
4. Apply post-alignment filters deliberately and document what each one
   removes.
5. Accept the alignment branch only if sort order, indexing, and summary
   files all match the delivered BAM.

## Alignment Basics

- **Aligner choice matters**: Different aligners (Bowtie2, BWA, minimap2,
  HISAT2, STAR) have different sensitivity, speed, and intended use

item_id: wf_003_host_contamination_removal
query: 'Filter the provided paired-end reads against the hg38 human reference assembly
  using a suitable paired-end short-read aligner.

  Remove read pairs that the selected aligner classifies as valid paired-end alignments
  to the human reference under its standard paired-end criteria, and retain all other
  pairs. Do not trim or otherwise modify the retained reads, and keep the two output
  files synchronized.

  Write the synchronized retained mates to `final_answer/filtered_forward.fastqsanger.gz`
  and `final_answer/filtered_reverse.fastqsanger.gz`.

  Write `final_answer/method.json` as a JSON object with a single key `aligner` whose
  value is the common name of the aligner you used.

  '

/usr/bin/bash -lc "set -euo pipefail
R1=/workspace/data/inputs/short_reads/pair/forward/forward.fastqsanger.gz

FILTER_PERL='use strict; use warnings; my "'$rmfile = shift @ARGV; open my $rm, "<", $rmfile or die "open remove list: $!'"\\n\"; my %remove; while (my "'$id = <$rm>) { chomp $id; $remove{$id} = 1; } my $records = 0; my $kept = 0; while (defined(my $h = <STDIN>)) { my $s = <STDIN>; my $p = <STDIN>; my $q = <STDIN>; die "truncated FASTQ after $h'"\\n\" unless defined "'$s && defined $p && defined $q; my ($id) = ($h =~ /''^@('"\\S+)/); die \"bad FASTQ header: "'$h'"\\n\" unless defined "'$id; $records++; if (!$remove{$id}) { print $h, $s, $p, $q; $kept++; } } warn "records=$records kept=$kept'"\\n\";'
printf 'filter_start_utc=%s\\n' \""'$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> /workspace/run_trace/execution.log
gzip -dc "$R1" | perl -e "$FILTER_PERL" "$RM" 2> /workspace/run_trace/filter_forward.stderr.log | gzip -c > "$TMP1"
gzip -dc "$R2" | perl -e "$FILTER_PERL" "$RM" 2> /workspace/run_trace/filter_reverse.stderr.log | gzip -c > "$TMP2"
gzip -t "$TMP1" "$TMP2"
mv "$TMP1" /workspace/final_answer/filtered_forward.fastqsanger.gz
mv "$TMP2" /workspace/final_answer/filtered_reverse.fastqsanger.gz
printf '"'filter_done_utc=%s\\n' \""'$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> /workspace/run_trace/execution.log'

events.command:
/usr/bin/bash -lc "set -euo pipefail
F=/workspace/final_answer/filtered_forward.fastqsanger.gz
R=/workspace/final_answer/filtered_reverse.fastqsanger.gz
RM=/workspace/work/filter/remove_proper_pair_qnames.txt
mkdir -p /workspace/work/filter/validation
{
  printf 'validation_utc=%s\\n' \""'$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  printf '"'final_answer_files:\\n'
  find /workspace/final_answer -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\\t%s bytes\\n' | LC_ALL=C sort
  printf 'gzip_test:\\n'
  gzip -t \""'$F" "$R" && printf '"'OK\\n'
  printf 'record_counts:\\n'
  printf 'input_forward\\t'; gzip -dc /workspace/data/inputs/short_reads/pair/forward/forward.fastqsanger.gz | awk 'END{print NR/4}'
  printf 'input_reverse\\t'; gzip -dc /workspace/data/inputs/short_reads/pair/reverse/reverse.fastqsanger.gz | awk 'END{print NR/4}'
  printf 'removed_proper_pairs\\t'; wc -l < \""'$RM"
  printf '"'filtered_forward\\t'; gzip -dc \""'$F" | awk '"'END{print NR/4}'
  printf 'filtered_reverse\\t'; gzip -dc \""'$R" | awk '"'END{print NR/4}'
  printf 'filter_forward_log\\t'; tr '\\n' ' ' < /workspace/run_trace/filter_forward.stderr.log; printf '\\n'
  printf 'filter_reverse_log\\t'; tr '\\n' ' ' < /workspace/run_trace/filter_reverse.stderr.log; printf '\\n'
  printf 'method_json\\t'; perl -MJSON::PP -0777 -ne 'my "'$x=decode_json($_); die unless keys(%$x)==1 && $x->{aligner} eq "BWA"; print "OK'"\\n\"' /workspace/final_answer/method.json
} > /workspace/run_trace/validation_summary.txt

gzip -dc \""'$F" | awk '"'NR%4==1{sub(/"'^@/,""); split($0,a,/ /); print a[1]}'"' > /workspace/work/filter/validation/filtered_forward.qnames
gzip -dc \""'$R" | awk '"'NR%4==1{sub(/"'^@/,""); split($0,a,/ /); print a[1]}'"' > /workspace/work/filter/validation/filtered_reverse.qnames
diff -q /workspace/work/filter/validation/filtered_forward.qnames /workspace/work/filter/validation/filtered_reverse.qnames >> /workspace/run_trace/validation_summary.txt
LC_ALL=C sort /workspace/work/filter/validation/filtered_forward.qnames > /workspace/work/filter/validation/filtered_forward.qnames.sorted
intersection_count="'$(comm -12 /workspace/work/filter/validation/filtered_forward.qnames.sorted "$RM" | wc -l)
printf '"'retained_removed_intersection\\t%s\\n' \""'$intersection_count" >> /workspace/run_trace/validation_summary.txt
md5sum "$F" "$R" /workspace/final_answer/method.json > /workspace/run_trace/final_md5sums.txt
cat /workspace/run_trace/validation_summary.txt
cat /workspace/run_trace/final_md5sums.txt'
